_about: Example policy for a professional photographer. Illustrative, not a tested configuration.
Layout: Shoots/<YYYY-MM-DD> <Client> <Type>/{RAW,Selects,Export}/ with .xmp sidecars next to the RAW files.
The catalog (e.g. a Lightroom Classic .lrcat and its previews) lives on the internal disk, outside the synced root.
The shoot date in the folder name opens the culling/editing window; a 'delivery' calendar adds
gallery delivery and album proofing dates; a Finder tag 'Portfolio' marks images that always stay.

rules.note: Sidecars hold the edits and are a few KB each.
The picks are what clients ask for again.
From the day before the shoot until three weeks after: import, cull, edit.
Gallery delivery, album proofing, print orders: the whole shoot comes back for a few days.
A wedding is often 100 GB or more of RAW. With Smart Previews you can still edit after the originals leave.
